scope: POSTHOC high-capacity q-PCA deployment diagnosis on already-used cosine taper7.5 new16 systems. Same 1024 training medium labels, same saved 60/100/140 Hz clean dense low-band context and same known source/PDE as speed255 and q255, no true test medium or target in inference. Compare rank768 linear q prior against frozen original speed255/q255 results only as a capacity/time tradeoff; rank768 uses 3x per-environment code and 3x q shared basis storage, and 5+5 GN iterations do not imply matched wall time. Two initialization precisions were fixed in prior matched-rank experiment. No formal independent-test status or gate.
